status_note: Repairs findings F1-F3 and items 1-8 of RESPONSE_TO_CODEX_STATISTICAL_REVIEW.md. Awaiting: Codex re-review, pilot report, PI certification.
purpose: Single machine-readable source of truth for every decision-bearing validation rule. The prose chapter drifted from the accepted per-entry corrections (finding F1) because nothing checked it. This register is the authority; tools/check_protocols.py enforces completeness and consistency, and the chapter and BUILD_PROGRAM register are checked against it.

confirmatory_families.decision: Per-gate Holm-Bonferroni over decision-bearing statistical tests only.
confirmatory_families.rationale: Gates are separate decisions taken at different times on different data with different release consequences, so the family is the gate, not the program. A single family across all 15 entries and 30+ weeks would cost power on the tier-0 floor tests for no inferential gain. Deterministic vetoes and reproduction checks are not null-hypothesis tests and carry no alpha.

tier0_gate.note: V01, V02, V03 are hard vetoes and V14 is a reproduction check; all four are pass/fail on deterministic criteria and consume no alpha.

tier1_gate.note: V13 vetoes are deterministic; V13's agreement check is a calibration criterion, not a ranking claim, and is excluded from the family.

tier2_gate.note: Single confirmatory primary. The 3-repetition run is exploratory and consumes no alpha (see V08.exploratory_tripwire).

tier3_v07.note: Electives are independent go/no-go decisions taken at different times, so each is its own family rather than one shared tier-3 family.

tier3_v15.note: Fixed-sequence (gatekeeping) pair: V15b is only tested if V15a rejects. A fixed sequence holds the family-wise rate at alpha without correction because the second hypothesis is only reached when the first was rejected, so the correction denominator is 1 despite two members. The order is prespecified here, which is the condition that makes the procedure valid; reordering after seeing results would void the error control.

confirmatory_families.repeated_looks: One prespecified scalar endpoint per entry. Performance-over-budget curves are reported for readability and are descriptive; a budget point may not be selected after inspecting a curve. Where a curve is decision-bearing, the entry names a summary functional (e.g. normalized area under the regret curve) fixed before data.
confirmatory_families.multi_comparator: Where a method must beat more than one comparator, the entry sets combination='intersection-union' and must clear every comparator at the family-adjusted level. Where beating any one comparator suffices, the entry sets combination='union' and the comparators enter the family as separate members.

power.high_target_rationale: Power protects against false demotion. V04-T1 (TuRBO, ~10 engineer-days) and V08 (BG-PBT flagship, the largest campaign in the program) carry sunk build cost that a false demotion would waste, so their false-negative cost is asymmetrically high. Cheaper capabilities whose demotion means 'ships opt-in instead of default' (V05, V11) keep 0.8.
power.method_detail: Sample size is obtained by Monte Carlo simulation under the entry's own hierarchy (task cluster, then paired study block), not from a closed-form t-test formula, because the estimand is a cluster-level paired difference and the closed form does not apply. 2,000 simulation replicates per candidate n; report attained power and interval coverage.
power.min_pilot_note: Per arm per side. Raised from the 3 implied by the chapter: 3 replicates give a variance estimate too noisy to size a campaign on. V08 remains the declared exception and does not size from pilot variance (see V08).
power.pilot_variance_detail: Size against the upper 80% confidence bound on the pilot variance estimate, not the point estimate, so that pilot noise inflates the sample rather than shrinking it. Pilot variance is frozen before the confirmatory campaign begins and is never revised during it.
power.pilot_data_reuse_detail: Pilot observations do not enter the confirmatory estimate. Pilot and confirmatory campaigns use disjoint seed sets.
power.sidedness_source: Each entry declares direction and sidedness; the power calculation uses the same sidedness and the same family-adjusted alpha as the confirmatory test.
power.max_sample_rule: Every entry carries an integer maximum sample. Reaching it without crossing the decision threshold yields verdict='inconclusive', which is a real outcome with the consequence named in the entry's release_consequence.

escalation.detail: An 'inconclusive' verdict permits at most one replication, whose budget, owner, and stopping rule are fixed before the first confirmatory result is seen. After that replication the verdict is terminal and resolves to the entry's release_consequence.inconclusive. This closes the review's objection that inconclusive had no funder and no end.

resampling.detail: Resample task clusters with replacement; within each selected task, resample complete paired study blocks with replacement, retaining arm pairing inside the block. Never resample individual trials: trials within a tuning run are adaptively selected and are not exchangeable.
resampling.draws_note: 10,000 draws bound Monte Carlo error of the interval, not the cluster count. With ~10 clusters the interval is wide however many draws are taken; the entry's task_scope states the resulting inferential limit.
resampling.pairing_definition: A paired block is the set of arms sharing the same task and the same optimizer seed. Pairing is used only where every arm in the block ran to the declared endpoint under the same accounting policy.
resampling.unpaired_fallback: Declared per entry before data collection, never chosen after inspecting results. An entry may only fall back to unpaired if its pairing precondition (identical task, identical seed, identical accounting policy across arms) fails for a prespecified reason recorded in the manifest.
resampling.single_cluster_rule: An entry whose acceptance set holds one task may not claim a workload-family result. Its task_scope is 'pinned-task' and its wording is limited accordingly.

scale.rationale: Percentage margins are undefined when the baseline objective is zero or negative (RL return routinely is) and are ambiguous when the denominator is itself estimated in the campaign. Range normalization fixes the denominator before data.
scale.definition: normalized_difference = (arm_value - comparator_value) / (bound_high - bound_low), where bounds are declared in the entry's scale_bounds and frozen in the pre-run manifest.
scale.direction_note: All differences are sign-flipped so that positive always means better, regardless of whether the raw objective is maximized or minimized.

missingness.default: A study replicate that fails to reach its declared endpoint is not silently dropped. The entry declares whether the replicate is (a) excluded with its paired block, (b) carried forward at last observed value, or (c) treated as worst-case. Missingness above 10% of planned replicates in any arm voids the campaign and triggers re-run after diagnosis.

preregistration_order: Commit analysis code and protocol register; obtain commit SHA
Freeze task registry, seed sets, and scale bounds; obtain registry digest
Build manifest referencing commit SHA and registry digest; sign it
Verify manifest (tools/verify_manifest.py) — run is refused if verification fails
Embed manifest digest in every result artifact
Analyze; gate report cites manifest digest

open_decisions.question: Confirmatory family scope: per-gate (chosen) vs global across all 15 entries vs hierarchical gatekeeping.
open_decisions.impact: Global correction would roughly halve tier-0 power; hierarchical gatekeeping would let a tier-0 failure close later families automatically.

open_decisions.question: Power target: 0.8 default with 0.9 for V04-T1 and V08 (chosen), vs 0.9 throughout.
open_decisions.impact: 0.9 throughout raises campaign cost materially on V06 and V09 for entries whose false-demotion cost is low.

open_decisions.question: V08 hold semantics: time-limited opt-in with auto-demotion on expiry (chosen), vs hold blocks the beta gate.
open_decisions.impact: Blocking beta on a hold makes the flagship a launch dependency. Opt-in with expiry keeps launch unblocked but requires the follow-up campaign to be funded at approval time, not later.

open_decisions.question: V06 primary cost estimand: active accelerator-seconds (chosen), vs elapsed wall-clock.
open_decisions.rationale: Local hardware, not cloud. Billed seconds collapse to active compute. The real cost is opportunity: what else could have run on that GPU. Wall-clock penalizes an arm for unrelated contention. Active accelerator-seconds is the honest measure of GPU occupancy.
open_decisions.impact: Primary is now GPU-seconds; wall-clock and queue wait are secondaries for diagnosis only.

open_decisions.question: Required sign-off level before confirmatory campaigns.
open_decisions.rationale: PI is a professor in computational statistics and global head of ML at a major bank. Codex surfaces issues; PI rules on them. External statistician would cost ~1 week and is unlikely to add material value beyond PI's domain expertise.
open_decisions.procedure: Codex re-reviews the repaired protocols and chapter. Any items flagged as potentially unsound are raised to PI for ruling. PI certifies the final protocol set before any campaign spend.
open_decisions.note: The review stated explicitly it is engineering review, not credentialed external certification (RESPONSE_TO_CODEX_STATISTICAL_REVIEW.md, amendment 8). With PI as the statistical authority, that certification is internal rather than external.

V01.claim: each wrapped searcher/scheduler matches its reference implementation on tabular benchmarks
V01.estimand: Equality in distribution between our wrapper and the vendor reference on tabular benchmarks at shared seeds and matched budget.
V01.test_detail: Two-sample distributional comparison (Kolmogorov-Smirnov on final scores, plus per-rung anytime scores) at shared seeds. Replaces the rejected fixed 0.5% tolerance, which assumed a determinism the references do not have.
V01.primary_endpoint: Distributional equivalence of final and anytime score vectors.
V01.repetition_unit: complete optimizer run at a shared seed
V01.alpha_note: Deterministic veto; consumes no family alpha. A divergence is a wiring bug, not a ranking claim.
V01.missingness: Any failed reference run voids that comparison and is re-run; it is never dropped.
V01.stopping_rule: Fixed sample. Veto fires on any divergence outside the declared band.

release_consequence.pass: Wrapper is trusted for tier-0 use.
release_consequence.fail: Tier 1 is blocked until the wiring defect is found and fixed.

repairs: accepted correction: distributional regression, not 0.5% tolerance

V02.test_detail: Replay of recorded curves plus state-machine and property tests over out-of-order, duplicate, late, and dropped events, and straggler injection. Clean replay alone was insufficient per the accepted correction.
V02.primary_endpoint: Zero specification violations across the generated event orderings.
V02.alpha_note: Deterministic veto; consumes no family alpha.
V02.missingness: Not applicable; fixtures are deterministic replays.
V02.stopping_rule: Fixed number of generated cases. Any violation fails the entry outright.

release_consequence.fail: Scheduler is not shipped; the defect is fixed and the suite re-run.

V03.test_detail: Mutation testing with a declared minimum kill score, replacing the rejected three hand-planted defects. Mutation operators cover rung off-by-one, dropped seed, swapped objective sign, and event reordering.

V06.estimand: Joint claim: (a) quality of searcher+ASHA is non-inferior to searcher-at-full-fidelity within margin delta on a range-normalized scale, and (b) the upper confidence bound on the active-accelerator-second cost ratio is at or below one third.
V06.margin_justification: A 5% range-normalized quality loss is the largest degradation that would not change the default recommendation to enable ASHA. This is a product tolerance, not an estimate from observed noise, and is fixed before data per the review's item-1 requirement.
V06.combination_note: Both the quality non-inferiority condition and the cost bound must clear. Passing on quality while cost overruns is not a pass, and vice versa.
V06.primary_endpoint: Paired non-inferiority on normalized final quality AND upper 95% confidence bound of the cost ratio <= 1/3.
V06.cost_estimand_detail: Active accelerator-seconds is the primary: the honest measure of GPU occupancy on local hardware. The real cost is opportunity — what else could have run on that GPU. V06.cost_uncertainty: The cost ratio carries a paired cluster bootstrap interval; the gate reads its upper bound, not a point estimate.
V06.cost_attribution: Shared startup and queue time is attributed deterministically per trial by allocation record. Both arms run under the same scheduling policy and the same hardware; heterogeneous hardware voids the comparison.
V06.scale_bounds: Per-task, declared in the task registry before data.
V06.repetition_unit: complete study replicate (paired by task and optimizer seed)
V06.task_scope: acceptance RL task set (multiple independent tasks)

V09.margin_justification: A 5% normalized hypervolume shortfall is the largest gap that would still leave the premium searcher worth its tier. Ties demote to option per the survey's declared rule.
V09.combination_note: qLogNEHVI must clear both comparators at the family-adjusted level to hold its tier slot. Beating only NSGA-II does not earn the premium slot.
V09.primary_endpoint: Cluster-level paired mean difference in final hypervolume against the frozen reference point.
V09.frozen_source: Reference point and normalization are set from declared domain bounds in the task registry, never from observed campaign results.
V09.scale_bounds: Declared domain bounds per objective in the task registry.
V09.repetition_unit: complete study replicate (paired by task and optimizer seed)

V10.claim: cheap MO fidelity signals may cull
V10.estimand: Operational error of early culling on the short-horizon drift signal: the probability that a configuration which would be top-k or Pareto-optimal at full fidelity is culled at the rung.
V10.test_detail: Association alone is insufficient: a high rank correlation does not bound the probability of culling a future good configuration. The gate now reads operational error metrics, with correlation retained as a secondary descriptor.
V10.combination_note: All safety criteria must clear. Failing any one leaves the signal advisory.
V10.primary_endpoint: Upper 95% confidence bound on false-cull probability for top-k configurations at or below 0.05, AND lower bound on top-k survivor recall at or above 0.90.
secondary_endpoints: Spearman rank correlation with bootstrap interval (descriptive)
normalized regret of the culled set (decision-bearing, adjusted interval)
V10.scale_bounds: Not applicable by construction: both primary endpoints are probabilities bounded in [0, 1] (false-cull probability, top-k survivor recall), so they need no range normalization against declared objective bounds. The secondary regret endpoint is range-normalized per task using the same registry bounds as V09.
V10.seeds_note: Raised from the single fixed seed of the rejected design. One seed per configuration confounds training-seed variance with configuration quality and cannot estimate false-cull probability at all.
V10.repetition_unit: configuration evaluated across multiple training seeds, clustered by task
V10.task_scope_note: Multiple tasks are required; the rejected single-task design could not support the workload-family claim the scheduler relies on.
V10.rung_selection: The candidate rung is fixed before acceptance data is seen and is recorded in the manifest.
V10.max_sample_note: Configurations, not runs. Total runs is max_sample x seeds_per_config x tasks.
V10.missingness: A configuration whose full-fidelity run fails is excluded from both the rung and endpoint vectors and is reported.
V10.stopping_rule: Fixed configuration budget sized by simulation; at max_sample without clearing, verdict is inconclusive.

release_consequence.pass: MO-ASHA may kill on the drift signal.
release_consequence.fail: Scheduler still runs but the signal is advisory; promotion falls back to the objective that does correlate.
release_consequence.inconclusive: Signal stays advisory; one pre-budgeted replication permitted, then terminal.

repairs: F1: gate now reads top-k recall and false-cull probability, not correlation alone
F1: multiple seeds and multiple tasks replace 100 configs at one fixed seed
accepted correction: multiple seeds/tasks, gate on top-k recall and false-cull probability

V11a.primary_endpoint: Cluster-level paired mean normalized difference in final objective.
V11a.implementation_requirement: Tests the actual piBO decay multiplier and the actual PriorBand rung portfolio. GP-mean substitution and top-K sampling are different methods and do not satisfy this entry.
V11a.prior_support_requirement: The declared prior must place nonzero density on the region containing the no-prior arm's optimum, verified and recorded before the campaign; a prior with zero support there makes the comparison vacuous.
V11a.scale_bounds: Per-task, declared in the task registry before data.
V11a.repetition_unit: complete study replicate (paired by task and optimizer seed)
V11a.missingness: Replicate failing to reach the declared endpoint is excluded with its paired block; >10% loss in any arm voids the campaign.
V11a.stopping_rule: Size from pilot at the family-adjusted alpha; at max_sample without clearing, verdict is inconclusive.

release_consequence.inconclusive: Remains opt-in; one pre-budgeted replication permitted, then terminal.

V13.claim: sampler correctness cannot be bought by speed
V13.estimand: Two separable questions: (a) do the absolute correctness vetoes hold, and (b) does the candidate sampler's posterior agree with a frozen reference posterior within Monte Carlo error.
V13.test_detail: Simulation-based calibration fixtures replace visual inspection. Multimodality is detected by an automated diagnostic, not by looking at trace plots, and chains are never re-initialized on the basis of an inspection that happened after seeing the data.
vetoes: Any configuration with a divergent transition is never promoted.
Any configuration with rank-normalized split R-hat above 1.01 on any monitored marginal is never promoted.
Any configuration with bulk-ESS or tail-ESS below 400 is never promoted.
A single promotion of a veto-failing configuration fails the entry outright.
V13.veto_note: Vetoes are absolute and deterministic; they consume no family alpha. The false-veto rate is a declared cost of conservatism and is reported in the gate report.
V13.calibration_check: Simulation-based calibration over declared fixtures: rank statistics of the true parameter within the posterior draws must be uniform, tested by the SBC rank histogram with a simultaneous band.
V13.agreement_check: MCSE-aware and interval-based: the candidate posterior mean must lie within a Monte Carlo standard error band of the frozen reference mean, with the band accounting for both samplers' MCSE, and the criterion applied simultaneously across monitored marginals rather than one at a time.
V13.agreement_note: Replaces the rejected 'within one standard error of the reference mean' rule, which was a weak single-marginal test that ignored simultaneity and treated the reference as exact.
V13.multimodality_diagnostic: Automated: mixture-component detection on pooled draws plus between-chain mode disagreement statistic, both with declared thresholds. Dispersed re-initialization is a preregistered protocol branch, not a post hoc response.
V13.sampling_protocol: Four independent chains per configuration from dispersed initializations; 2,000 warmup draws discarded plus 2,000 retained per chain (8,000 retained total). Reference posterior uses the same four-chain protocol with 20,000 retained draws per chain.
V13.ranking_rule: Survivors are ranked by effective sample size per gradient evaluation, measured by the executor. Speed enters only after the vetoes and the calibration and agreement checks pass.
V13.primary_endpoint: All vetoes hold, SBC ranks are uniform within the simultaneous band, and simultaneous MCSE-aware agreement holds across monitored marginals.
V13.task_scope: sampler workload fixtures plus the pinned Hamiltonian posterior
V13.alpha_note: Vetoes and calibration are correctness criteria, not ranking claims, so V13 consumes no family alpha. Multiplicity across monitored marginals is handled by the simultaneous band, not by Holm-Bonferroni over a confirmatory family.
V13.missingness: A chain that fails to complete voids its configuration, which is re-run; a failed chain is never analyzed as a shorter chain.
V13.stopping_rule: Fixed fixture set. Any veto breach fails the entry outright.

release_consequence.fail: Sampler workload does not ship until the correctness defect is fixed.

repairs: F1: visual multimodality inspection replaced with automated diagnostics
F1: one-standard-error agreement replaced with simultaneous MCSE-aware intervals
F1: SBC fixtures added
accepted correction: SBC fixtures, rank-normalized R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, MCSE-aware comparisons, automated mode diagnostics

V08.claim: the population line does not lose in its home regime
V08.estimand: Range-normalized difference in final objective between the population line and each comparator, as a cluster-level paired mean, evaluated separately on each side of the eight-worker boundary.
V08.home_regime_definition: Above the boundary: 16 workers. Below: 4 workers. 'Home regime' is the above-boundary side; the below-boundary side is run to establish that the method does not win only by consuming parallelism, and its result cannot alone produce a pass.
V08.margin_justification: A 5% range-normalized shortfall in the home regime is the largest gap that would still leave the flagship worth defaulting to at 16 workers. Product tolerance, fixed before data.
V08.combination_note: Non-inferiority must hold against both comparators on the above-boundary side for a pass.
V08.primary_endpoint: Paired non-inferiority of normalized final objective against both comparators on the 16-worker side, at matched measured compute.
V08.scale_bounds: Declared per task in the task registry before data.
V08.repetition_unit: complete study replicate (paired by task and optimizer seed, within worker-count side)
V08.task_scope_note: One task, so the claim is pinned-task (policy.resampling.single_cluster_rule).
V08.power_note: 0.9 per policy.power.high_target_entries: BG-PBT is the flagship and the most expensive build in the program, so a false demotion is the costliest error in the suite.

exploratory_tripwire.purpose: The 3-repetition run is an exploratory tripwire only. It can trigger demotion or continuation; it can never produce a pass. This resolves finding F3, where the declared exception could not make the flagship green at its own gate.
exploratory_tripwire.ordering_statistic: Mean range-normalized difference against the worse of the two comparators, computed per side.
exploratory_tripwire.demotion_trigger: All three repetitions show the population line behind the same comparator on the 16-worker side AND the mean normalized shortfall exceeds 0.10.
exploratory_tripwire.min_loss_margin_note: A consistent ordering in three noisy repetitions is not by itself evidence of a loss, so a bare ordering does not demote; the shortfall must also exceed twice the decision margin.
exploratory_tripwire.tie_rule: A normalized difference within +/-0.02 is a tie and does not count toward the consistent-ordering condition.
exploratory_tripwire.missing_run_rule: Fewer than three completed repetitions on a side cannot trigger demotion; the tripwire is re-run.
exploratory_tripwire.false_demotion_risk: Reported in the gate report as the simulated probability of this trigger firing under a true null, estimated from the pilot hierarchy. The tripwire is deliberately asymmetric and this is its declared cost.

V08.promotion_route: A full powered campaign at power_target and max_sample is the only route to pass.
V08.missingness: Replicate failing to reach the declared endpoint is excluded with its paired block; >10% loss in any arm on a side voids that side.
V08.stopping_rule: Tripwire first; if it does not demote, the powered campaign runs. At max_sample without clearing, verdict is hold.

release_consequence.pass: BG-PBT ships as the default for rl_large_parallel.
release_consequence.fail: Demote to an option; rl_large_parallel defaults to whichever of DEHB or BO+ASHA won V07. If V07 tied or was inconclusive, the default is DEHB, declared here so the fallback is not undefined at gate time.
release_consequence.hold: Ships opt-in only, with no default dispatch, under a named owner, a dated expiry, and a funded powered follow-up campaign. If the expiry passes without the follow-up completing, the entry auto-demotes to option. Hold does not block the internal beta gate.
release_consequence.implementation_fail: Distinct from a method loss: the population manager did not run correctly. Not a demotion; the defect is fixed and the campaign re-run.

repairs: F3: pass is now reachable via the powered campaign; the 3-rep run is explicitly exploratory
item 8: ordering statistic, tie rule, missing-run rule, minimum loss margin, and false-demotion risk all defined
item 8: hold has an owner, expiry, budget, and auto-demotion
item 8: home regime defined, both sides specified, V07 fallback tie-break declared
accepted correction: define initial status and green meaning, both sides, sequential maximum sample

V12.estimand: Cluster-level paired mean reduction in trials required to reach the cold-start arm's final objective value, expressed as a fraction of the cold-start trial count.
V12.margin_justification: Below a 20% trial saving, warm starting is not worth defaulting on: the store lookup and transfer machinery costs more in complexity than it returns. Product tolerance, fixed before data.
V12.primary_endpoint: Paired mean fractional trial saving to reach the cold-start arm's final value, lower 95% confidence bound at or above 0.20.
V12.endpoint_note: The target value is the cold-start arm's own final value on the same task and seed, fixed within the paired block, so the endpoint is not a moving target estimated across arms.
V12.precondition: The run store must hold at least ten completed studies from the same model family (same architecture class, same task domain) before the campaign runs. Below that the warm-start query has no history to learn from and the entry is not run.
V12.precondition_gate_note: This precondition is why V12 sits at the Distributed Beta gate rather than Tier 1: the store only accumulates enough same-family studies after Tier 0 through Tier 2 campaigns have run. The survey assigns V12 to T1+, meaning tier 1 or later, so this placement is consistent with the survey.
V12.scale_bounds: Trial counts are non-negative integers; the fractional saving is bounded in [0, 1] by construction.
V12.repetition_unit: complete study replicate (paired by task and optimizer seed)
V12.task_scope: new studies on familiar model families (multiple independent tasks)
V12.missingness: A replicate whose cold-start arm never reaches a stable final value is excluded with its paired block; >10% loss voids the campaign.
V12.stopping_rule: Size from pilot at the family-adjusted alpha; at max_sample without clearing, verdict is inconclusive.

release_consequence.pass: Warm start is on by default for recognized model families.
release_consequence.inconclusive: Remains opt-in; one pre-budgeted replication permitted, then terminal.

repairs: gate assignment recovered: V12 was dropped from the corrected timeline entirely and is now placed at the Distributed Beta gate with its precondition stated
